profile: SQLite 3.47.2 with UTF-8 and numbered native parameters under the checked scalar profile.
scope: Resolve CAST to one of the five SQLite affinity roles with one checked scalar operand. Compose in the existing scalar expression locations.

cast.role: One checked conversion with the effective affinity of its type-name target
cast.structure: An immutable CastTarget and a single closed scalar operand.
cast.conditions: The owning statement checks the operand, including references, height, expanded nodes and literal payload. Analysis binds the effective affinity in the order of SQLite's type-name rules.
cast.meaning: Apply the selected conversion to the operand under SQLite's numeric, textual and byte rules. Preserve SQL NULL and the effective expression affinity for composition.
cast.externalInterpretation: The same input value and SQLite UTF-8 conversion rules, with any external fields or numbered bindings supplied in their resolved positions.
cast.sql: Emit CAST of the checked expression with the canonical type keyword for the stored affinity and preserve precedence.

target.role: The effective cast conversion and expression affinity
target.meaning: Select signed integer, real, numeric, text or binary conversion. NUMERIC retains a numeric operand's storage class and chooses the applicable numeric class for text and binary values.
target.sql: Use the literal keyword named by the enum value.

observations: Exact SQLite storage classes, numbers, Unicode text, text with arbitrary bytes, BLOB bytes and NULL
